objectives.statement: Understand foundational mental models and architecture of SQL
Implement secure, reproducible solutions across real-world SQL tasks
Diagnose common production edge cases, bottlenecks, and vulnerabilities in SQL
Architect scalable enterprise workflows aligned with SQL industry best practices

prerequisites: Basic familiarity with spreadsheets or structured data tables

modules.title: Module 1: Relational Modeling & Declarative Querying
modules.summary: Master keys, Third Normal Form (3NF), SQL logical execution order, filtering, NULL three-valued logic, and GROUP BY/HAVING aggregations.
lessonTitles: Relational Schema Design, Keys & Normal Forms (1NF–3NF)
Filtering, Sorting & Grouping Data with SELECT/WHERE/HAVING
modules.checkpoint: Design normalized schemas and author accurate multi-condition grouped reports.

modules.title: Module 2: Multi-Table Joins, CTEs & Window Functions
modules.summary: Master INNER, LEFT, and SELF joins without outer-join bugs, structure clear Common Table Expressions (CTEs), and rank/aggregate across sliding windows.
lessonTitles: Multi-Table INNER, LEFT, FULL Joins & CTEs
Analytical Window Functions: ROW_NUMBER, RANK & Running Totals
modules.checkpoint: Solve complex Top-N per group analytics and running cumulative totals without correlated subqueries.

modules.title: Module 3: Indexing, Transactions & Performance Tuning
modules.summary: Design B-Tree & composite indexes, inspect EXPLAIN ANALYZE plans, implement keyset pagination, and enforce atomic ACID transactions.
lessonTitles: B-Tree Indexes, EXPLAIN Query Plans & Avoiding Scans
ACID Transactions, Isolation Levels & Safe Migrations
modules.checkpoint: Eliminate slow full-table scans and guard financial/state updates against race conditions.

practiceActivities: Design normalized 3NF relational tables linking students, courses, and enrollments
Author analytical TOP-N per group queries via ROW_NUMBER() window functions
Optimize full-table scan filters via composite B-Tree indexes and keyset pagination
assessmentCheckpoints: Module 1: Relational Modeling & Declarative Querying Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 2: Multi-Table Joins, CTEs & Window Functions Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 3: Indexing, Transactions & Performance Tuning Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
projects: E-Commerce & Learning Analytics Relational Database Schema + Query Performance Benchmark
proficiencyCriteria: Model normalized relational tables enforcing PRIMARY, FOREIGN, and CHECK integrity
Write expressive multi-table JOINs, CTEs, GROUP BY aggregations, and Window Functions
Interpret EXPLAIN query plans and guarantee atomic ACID transactions cleanly
